1.name: The Strange Mouse Cursor
1.overview: During IT class, Takumi notices that his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen. He asks his childhood friend Mone, who's sitting next to him, if she can see it, but she can't and just makes fun of him… Assuming she can't see it, Takumi slips the cursor into the gap in Mone's clothes and starts clicking on her body! As he continues clicking on Mone, who's writhing in pleasure from this unfamiliar sensation, the words "The Real Deal" eventually appear in the right-click menu… Huh? "The Real Deal", is that what I think it is?!

1.name: Error: Insufficient Click Point
1.overview: As a result of continuously clicking on Mone in the nurse's office, the unthinkable happens with "The Real Deal" appearing in the right-click menu! Takumi instinctively clicks it, but what appeared next was a strange error message reading, "Insufficient click points." His dream of "The Real Deal" ends in failure… On top of that, the possibility suddenly arose that Kaoru, a mysterious girl in his class, might have witnessed the whole thing! Driven by anxiety, Takumi tails Kaoru—but what awaited him was an unexpected turn of events?!

1.name: Cut and Paste
1.overview: The 'Real Deal' feature finally activates! Pushed down by Kaoru, who had become even more aggressive than before, Takumi finds himself drowning in pleasure. The next day, faced with Mone's usual bossy attitude, Takumi launches another click attack! But her tie is in the way, preventing him from moving the cursor inside her clothes. Takumi selects 'Cut' for the tie from the right-click menu, but… Called over by a suspicious Mone, Takumi ends up treating her injury by chance. However, he was in for a surprise!

1.name: Unlock Dabble *** Brush
1.overview: Takumi, who had left Mone's tie 'Cut,' frantically clicks on 'Paste' to secure it. However, doing that to Mone in the classroom with everyone around caused a series of misunderstandings and chaos! Just then, Mirei, the art club president, appears to rescue him from that predicament—she'd come to drag Takumi away for skipping club activities. Takumi ends up alone with Mirei in the art room, working on a painting, but… Wait, no way... She can see the arrow too?!!

1.name: The Love Accelerator
1.overview: Suddenly, Kaoru invites Takumi out on his day off. Could this be… a date? They meet up and go see a movie Kaoru picked out, but… Huh? Wait, whoa… this is pretty adult-oriented… I mean, it's kind of a racy movie!! Flustered by Kaoru's relentless teasing, Takumi once again fights back with mouse cursor clicks! And the newly unlocked feature is Double Sensitivity Mode?! Kaoru is unable to contain her excitement any longer, and…!

1.name: Up Close! The Secret Mode
1.overview: Takumi and Mone were chosen to be in charge of posters for the cultural festival! However, Mone doesn't know how to use the computer for making the posters! And so Takumi has to do all the work! End of story! So, while Mone was watching Takumi work from the sidelines, she'd secretly seen him spending time with Kaoru on his day off, which made her feel a bit jealous. Combined with her embarrassment, she starts teasing him. As a result, they almost grow closer through a miraculous pervy accident, but just then, Mirei and Kaoru show up, and the two find themselves in a major crisis!

originalTitle: マウスカーソルで現実を操作できるようになったので、女の子をいっぱいクリックしまーす
overview:
One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen.

Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off...

Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...

Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"!
tagline: What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor?
title: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!
